title: Anxious · adj.
subtitle: 「焦慮的／擔心的／不安的／緊張的」，究竟是哪一種 anxious？
description: 「焦慮的／擔心的／不安的／緊張的」，究竟是哪一種 anxious？

words.note: 使用者提供。worried 是 anxious 最核心、最日常的近義詞之一，表示因可能出現的問題、壞結果或不確定情況而感到擔心。它比 apprehensive 更普通，也不一定包含明顯身體緊張感。
words.example: She felt worried about the delay in receiving the results.

exercises.original: He felt anxious about whether the application had been submitted correctly.
exercises.zh: 他擔心申請是否已正確提交。
exercises.upgrade: worried · 擔心的；憂慮的

options.explanation: whether ... correctly expresses concern about a possible problem rather than fear of a specific future event.
強調模糊的不安、懷疑或『事情不太對勁』的感覺。 本題的決定性線索是 general concern about a possible problem；這裡需要的是「一般對問題／結果的擔心」。因此 uneasy 雖與 anxious 有重疊，但是否強調一般擔心、模糊不安、未來事件、即時緊張、理性關注、深度困擾或持續警覺並不最吻合。
較正式，重點是對即將發生的事情或未知結果感到惴惴不安。 本題的決定性線索是 general concern about a possible problem；這裡需要的是「一般對問題／結果的擔心」。因此 apprehensive 雖與 anxious 有重疊，但是否強調一般擔心、模糊不安、未來事件、即時緊張、理性關注、深度困擾或持續警覺並不最吻合。

words.meaning: 不安的；心神不寧的；感到不踏實的
words.note: 使用者提供。uneasy 表示一種模糊、持續的不安感，常見於沒有完全確定發生了甚麼，但覺得事情不太對勁。它比 worried 更常帶 vague discomfort or suspicion。
words.example: I felt uneasy about the sudden change in his explanation.

exercises.original: She felt anxious about the silence in the normally busy office.
exercises.zh: 平日繁忙的辦公室突然一片寂靜，令她感到不安。
exercises.upgrade: uneasy · 不安的；心神不寧的；感到不踏實的

falseSynonyms.zh: worried 最日常、最廣；anxious 往往情緒更強，也可帶身體緊張感。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She was worried about the delay. She felt anxious before the interview.

falseSynonyms.zh: uneasy 強調模糊不安或懷疑；anxious 可以有非常明確的擔心對象。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I felt uneasy about his explanation. I was anxious about the exam result.

falseSynonyms.zh: apprehensive 特別聚焦即將發生的事情；一般長期問題則更適合 worried/concerned。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She was apprehensive about the interview. She was worried about the ongoing delays.

falseSynonyms.zh: nervous 常見於考試、面試、表演等即時壓力情境；anxious 的時間與原因範圍更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He was nervous before the presentation. He was anxious about the project's future.

falseSynonyms.zh: concerned 通常較理性、克制、正式；anxious 情緒張力更高。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Doctors are concerned about the trend. The patient felt anxious while waiting.

falseSynonyms.zh: troubled 通常較沉重，暗示嚴重問題、壞消息或道德困擾；一般小事不一定用 troubled。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She looked troubled by the allegations. He was anxious about being late.

falseSynonyms.zh: anxious 有一個較舊／較正式的義項可表示『熱切希望』，但現代一般用法中 anxious 更常理解為焦慮；eager 只表示熱切期待，不含擔心。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She was eager to begin. She was anxious about the result.

falseSynonyms.zh: anxious 是形容詞；anxiety 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He felt anxious. He experienced anxiety.
